entities.summary: Gustav Adolf, Cardinal Prince of Hohenlohe-Schillingfürst, was a member of the Hohenlohe family of Germany, claiming descent from Eberhard, one of the early dukes of Franconia. He became a cardinal of the Catholic Church.
